children: Federal immigration agents arrested two people on a jetway at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday, prompting Washington Gov.
Bob Ferguson
to accuse Immigration and Customs Enforcement of reckless conduct during the boarding of an Alaska Airlines flight.

ICE officers moved in around 8 a.m. PST at Sea-Tac while passengers were getting onto an Alaska Airlines plane headed to Los Angeles, as reported in the primary account of the incident. The agency said the target was
Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza
, alleging he remained in the U.S. after his visa expired.
Alaska Airlines Incident Draws Criticism
ICE said a second traveler,
Sofia Hernandez Mejia
, was arrested after allegedly throwing hot coffee at officers. The agency also alleged that Mejia had overstayed her visa and said she would face a charge of assaulting a federal officer.
Ferguson, speaking at a Saturday news conference, said, “ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this.”
He also described the circulating video as “horrific” and “chilling,” saying he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports.”

Alaska Airlines said it was concerned about what happened and that it had not been warned ahead of time. The carrier said it was working to learn more about the circumstances surrounding the enforcement action.
April Sims

, president of the Washington State Labor Council, AFL-CIO, criticized the operation as a smash-and-grab that she said injected fear and confusion during a sensitive period for air travel. According to Reuters, Sims pointed to the timing coming shortly after nationwide travel disruptions, and she noted Sea-Tac was in one of the year’s busiest travel weeks.
Trump’s ICE Plan
President
Donald Trump
in March had floated

params.linkText: shifting ICE agents into U.S. airports

children: to perform security functions and make on-the-spot detentions, with a stated focus on immigrants from Somalia.

title: Washington Gov. Bob Ferguson Says ICE Is ‘Completely and Totally Out of Control’ After Sea-Tac Arrests
